//: Used in: components/billing/PaygSheet (paygSheet namespace). The pay-as-you-go RULE only — card management lives in CardSheet. Flow copy only; the method identity, pitch, status words and generic verbs come from the shared billing namespace. The {{surcharge}} disclosure must stay in `consent`/`disclosure`: it is the last statement of the fee before a card is authorized.
consent: Charge my card automatically for every share of my business, plus {{surcharge}} per charge.
disclosure: By linking a card you authorize automatic charges for shares of your business, plus {{surcharge}} per charge.
footnote: Any card. Turn it off anytime.
activeNote: Each share is charged to your card once its value is known, plus {{surcharge}} per charge. Credits are always used first.
offNote: Pay as you go is off. Turn it on to cover shares with this card once your credits run out.
failedNote: Your last charge failed. Update your card to turn pay as you go back on.
turnOn: Turn on pay as you go
verifyingBody: This usually takes a few seconds.
successTitle: Pay as you go is on
successBody: You'll be charged once each share's value is known.
turnOnSuccessTitle: Pay as you go is on
turnOnSuccessBody: You'll be charged once each share's value is known.
unverifiedTitle: We couldn't verify your card yet
unverifiedBody: If the link went through, pay as you go will turn on shortly. You can check the status in Wallet.
turnOffTitle: Turn off pay as you go?
turnOffBody: Shares will only be covered by your credits, and your business may stop being visible when they run out. Your card stays saved.
